text:
Marina: Heads-up — vendor flagged a connector/customs issue for the H200 racks bound for eu-west-1. ETA slipping ~3–5 weeks. Need quick capacity plan and short-term mitigations :warning:
Sam: Pulling reservation numbers now. Current reserved monthly GPU-hrs: H200=480000, H100=360000, L40S=120000 (burst pool). If H200 delayed 4 weeks we lose ~120k H200-hrs. :eyes:
Sam: Quick idea — shift non-urgent batch jobs to L40S and throttle low-priority interactive workloads. Rough estimate: move ~40% of batch -> L40S, frees ~48k H200-hrs equivalent. Will cost more per-token but keeps throughput.
Ravi: Cost note — L40S perf for our large-gen pipeline is ~1.6x slower, memory limits may force model sharding. That increases egress and instance churn. We should quantify delta before mass shift.
Jen: Agree. Also recommend we temporarily tighten preemption for background retrain/eval queues and pause non-critical canaries. Ops runbook update needed.
Procurement Bot: PO#78921 updated — expedited connector request submitted to vendor. They quoted provisional ETA 2025-04-12 (subject to customs).
Will: We can also route some steady traffic to us-east-1 H200 pools if capacity available there, but that adds cross-region latency and egress cost. Quick config snippet:
```
routing_policy:
  prefer_region: eu-west-1
  fallback_regions: [us-east-1]
  max_egress_per_min: 2000
```
Hao: Observability: create a short eval set to detect quality regressions when running on L40S/quantized variants. We should auto-rollback if perplexity or hallucination metrics cross threshold.
Sam: Numbers I ran locally: moving 48k H200-hrs -> L40S would increase monthly infra spend ~+12% for those workloads but keeps 99p latency SLO for interactive by offloading batch.
Ravi: Also track KV cache hit rate after model swaps — lower cache efficiency will hit token costs. Add a metric.
Marina: Action items: @Sam produce 2-week mitigation plan with cost delta, @Jen update ops runbook and pause list, @Will check cross-region capacity and egress estimate, @Hao prep quick eval suite. Procurement to keep pushing connector ETA and share PO updates. I'll sync with product tomorrow AM. Who owns communications to impacted customers?
Jen: I can draft a short customer note for account teams, will share for review.
Procurement Bot: Vendor message (automated): "Connector manifest updated, customs clearance initiated — tracking ID ZXC-44321."
Sam: I'll ping infra-capacity and attach a short spreadsheet with exact GPU-hour shifts in the thread (will post link). :rocket:
Marina: Thanks all — please add any blockers. If vendor confirms >5wk slip we trigger contingency plan #orange-fallback. :white_check_mark:
